attempts.summary: Set up a LUKS1-encrypted, loop-file-backed volume on node1 (RHEL7, no spare block device) mounted at /srv/secure, with a systemd oneshot service (srv-secure.service, WantedBy=local-fs.target) that auto-attaches the loop device, unlocks LUKS via a root-only keyfile, and mounts it at boot with no manual intervention. Verified end-to-end across an actual node restart: boot identity changed, volume re-unlocked and remounted automatically, and test data/checksum survived.
